items.title: Plan the week of 7 to 11 December
items.detail: Monday, Wednesday and Friday made again on 28 Nov: Monday has 4 options, Wednesday 2 and Friday 3 that pass every floor; every other fresh story found either went out already, sits on an earlier board, or holds only four whys. Researched with web search only: Drive and Firecrawl were not connected, so the Cold Ideas & Inspo folder was not read.
